description: This file defines a class 'ChartWarmUpCacheCommand' responsible for warming up cache for chart visualizations in the Superset project. It includes methods for handling legacy and non-legacy visualizations, retrieving dashboard filters, and executing cache warm-up logic.

classes.name: ChartWarmUpCacheCommand
classes.description: A command class to warm up cache for chart visualizations, handling both legacy and non-legacy types, with validation and execution methods.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the command with chart or chart ID, dashboard ID, and extra filters.

methods.name: _get_dashboard_filters
methods.description: Retrieves dashboard filters from extra_filters or dashboard metadata.

methods.name: _warm_up_legacy_cache
methods.description: Warms up cache for legacy visualizations using visualization payload.

methods.name: _warm_up_non_legacy_cache
methods.description: Warms up cache for non-legacy visualizations by executing data commands.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Validates and executes cache warming, returning chart ID, error, and status.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the chart or retrieves it from the database if only ID is provided.
